CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation feature is reliably bound to the same content/time (A ambiguous).

COD.rationale: Identified content (red at coordinates) is presented with a separate origin/representation field, satisfying C, O and D for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Report contains processing-origin labels (e.g. command_estimate/history_estimate) but no clearly labeled attention/allocation statement explicitly bound to the identified content; status therefore ambiguous.

C.rationale: The text explicitly identifies represented content (colour labels) and coordinates.

D.rationale: Content entries and separate origin/representation metadata are listed for the same referent, distinguishing identified content from its representation/access status.

O.rationale: An origin/representation field describes how the content is represented/accessed (representation time and kind).
